cases.sentence: ___ Иона Потапов весь бел, как привидение.
cases.translation: The cab driver Iona Potapov is entirely white, like a ghost.
cases.explain: «Извозчик» is the grammatical subject of the sentence (with «Иона Потапов» in apposition), so it stands in the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Кого оторвали от ___, от привычных серых картин и бросили сюда, в этот омут, тому нельзя не думать.
cases.translation: Whoever has been torn from the plough, from the familiar grey scenes, and thrown here into this whirlpool, cannot help but think.
cases.explain: The preposition «от» (away from) governs the genitive case, giving «плуга».

cases.sentence: И он оборачивается всем туловищем к ___ и говорит.
cases.translation: And he turns his whole body toward the passenger and says.
cases.explain: The preposition «к» (toward) governs the dative case, giving «седоку».

cases.sentence: Своей неподвижностью, угловатостью форм и палкообразной прямизной ног она даже вблизи похожа на копеечную пряничную ___.
cases.translation: With its stillness, angular shapes, and stick-like straight legs, it looks even up close like a penny gingerbread horse.
cases.explain: The expression «похожа на (кого-что)» governs the accusative case, giving «лошадку».

cases.sentence: Извозчик опять вытягивает шею, приподнимается и с тяжелой грацией взмахивает ___.
cases.translation: The cabman again stretches his neck, half-rises, and with heavy grace waves his whip.
cases.explain: The verb «взмахнуть чем» names the instrument used without a preposition, so it takes the instrumental case: «кнутом».

cases.translation: In the air there is closeness and stuffiness.
cases.explain: The preposition «в» marking location governs the prepositional case here, giving «воздухе».

reading.ru: Крупный мокрый снег лениво кружится около только что зажженных фонарей и тонким мягким пластом ложится на крыши, лошадиные спины, плечи, шапки.
reading.question: What is the weather like at the start of the story?
options: Large wet snow is lazily swirling around freshly lit streetlamps
It is a clear, starry night
reading.correct: Large wet snow is lazily swirling around freshly lit streetlamps
reading.explain: Large wet snow lazily swirls around the just-lit streetlamps and settles in a thin soft layer on roofs, horses' backs, shoulders, and hats.

reading.ru: Извозчик Иона Потапов весь бел, как привидение.
reading.question: How is the cab driver Iona Potapov described?
options: Entirely white, like a ghost, covered in snow
Dressed in a bright red coat
reading.correct: Entirely white, like a ghost, covered in snow
reading.explain: Iona Potapov is described as entirely white, like an apparition, from the snow covering him.

reading.ru: Его лошаденка тоже бела и неподвижна.
reading.question: What is also described as white and motionless like Iona?
reading.correct: His little horse
reading.explain: His little horse (лошадёнка) is also described as white and motionless.

reading.ru: Кого оторвали от плуга, от привычных серых картин и бросили сюда, в этот омут, полный чудовищных огней, неугомонного треска и бегущих лошадей, тому нельзя не думать.
reading.question: What does the narrator suggest about someone torn from rural life and thrown into the city?
options: Such a person cannot help but think/brood
Such a person quickly forgets their old life
Such a person becomes very happy
Such a person never adapts and leaves
reading.correct: Such a person cannot help but think/brood
reading.explain: The narrator says that whoever is torn from the plough and the familiar grey scenes and thrown into this whirlpool cannot help but think.

reading.ru: «Извозчик, на Выборгскую!» — слышит Иона.
reading.question: What is the first fare's destination that Iona hears called out?
reading.correct: Vyborgskaya
reading.explain: Iona hears a passenger calling out, 'Cabman, to Vyborgskaya!'

reading.ru: «Да ты спишь, что ли?
reading.question: What does the military passenger accuse Iona of doing?
reading.correct: Sleeping (being inattentive) while driving
reading.explain: The military passenger asks Iona, 'Are you asleep or what?' annoyed at his slow reaction.

reading.ru: «Куда прешь, леший?» На первых же парах слышит Иона возгласы из темной движущейся взад и вперед массы.
reading.question: What happens almost immediately as Iona starts driving through the crowded street?
options: He hears angry shouts from the crowd around him
He is stopped by a policeman
The passenger falls out of the sleigh
reading.correct: He hears angry shouts from the crowd around him
reading.explain: From the very first steps Iona hears shouted curses from the dark, moving mass of people and traffic.

reading.ru: «У меня барин того, сын на этой неделе помер».
reading.question: What news does Iona try to share with the military passenger?
options: That his son died this week
reading.correct: That his son died this week
reading.explain: Iona tells his passenger, 'Sir, you know, my son died this week.'

reading.ru: «Кто ж его знает, должный от горячки, три дня полежал в больнице и помер.
reading.question: How does Iona explain the cause of his son's death?
options: A fever; he lay three days in the hospital and died
reading.correct: A fever; he lay three days in the hospital and died
reading.explain: Iona explains that his son fell ill, apparently from a fever, spent three days in the hospital, and died.

reading.ru: По тротуару, громко стуча калошами и перебраниваясь, проходят трое молодых людей.
reading.question: Who does Iona pick up as his next fares?
options: Three young men walking along the pavement, arguing loudly
reading.correct: Three young men walking along the pavement, arguing loudly
reading.explain: Three young men pass by on the pavement, loudly stomping their galoshes and quarreling with each other.

reading.ru: После долгой перебранки, капризничая и попреков, приходит к решению, что стоять должен Горбач, как самый маленький.
reading.question: How do the three young men decide who will stand in the sledge?
options: The hunchback must stand because he is the smallest
The tallest one volunteers to stand
They take turns every few minutes
reading.correct: The hunchback must stand because he is the smallest
reading.explain: After a long argument, they decide that the hunchback should stand, since he is the smallest.

reading.ru: Вчера у Дукмасовых мы вдвоем с Васькой четыре бутылки коньяку выпили.
reading.question: What does one of the tall young men boast about doing the day before?
options: Drinking four bottles of cognac with Vaska at the Dukmasovs'
Winning a large sum at cards
reading.correct: Drinking four bottles of cognac with Vaska at the Dukmasovs'
reading.explain: One of the tall passengers boasts that he and Vaska drank four bottles of cognac at the Dukmasovs' house yesterday.

reading.ru: «А у меня на этой неделе того сын помер».
reading.question: What does Iona try to tell the three passengers, echoing what he told the soldier?
options: That his son died this week
That he needs to stop for water
That the fare is too low
reading.correct: That his son died this week
reading.explain: Iona again tries to tell his passengers that his son died this week.

reading.ru: «Все помрем», — вздыхает Горбач, вытирая после кашля губы.
reading.question: How does the hunchback (Gorbach) respond to hearing about Iona's son's death?
options: He bursts into tears of sympathy
He apologizes for his earlier rudeness
reading.correct: He sighs dismissively, 'We'll all die'
reading.explain: The hunchback sighs, 'We'll all die,' wiping his lips after coughing, showing indifference to Iona's grief.

reading.ru: Теперь у меня одна жена, сырая земля, ее могила то есть.
reading.question: How does Iona describe his 'wife' now, when asked if he is married?
options: The damp earth — meaning his wife's grave
A woman back in his home village
He says he has never married
A new woman he recently met
reading.correct: The damp earth — meaning his wife's grave
reading.explain: Iona says that now he has only one wife — the damp earth, that is, her grave.

reading.ru: Опять он одинок, и опять наступает для него тишина.
reading.question: How does Iona feel after the three passengers leave?
options: Alone again, with silence returning around him
Angry at being cheated of a good tip
reading.correct: Alone again, with silence returning around him
reading.explain: Once again he is alone, and once again silence descends on him.

reading.ru: Лопни грудь, Ионы, и вылезь из нее тоска, так она бы, кажется, весь свет залила.
reading.question: How vast does the narrator describe Iona's grief (toska) as being?
options: So vast that if it burst out of his chest it would flood the whole world
Shared equally by everyone in the city
reading.correct: So vast that if it burst out of his chest it would flood the whole world
reading.explain: The narrator says that if Iona's chest were to burst and his grief poured out, it would seem to flood the whole world.

reading.ru: Иона видит дворника с кульком и решает заговорить с ним.
reading.question: Who does Iona try to talk to about his grief next?
reading.correct: A caretaker/doorman carrying a bundle
reading.explain: Iona sees a caretaker with a bundle and decides to strike up a conversation with him.

reading.ru: Спустя часа полтора Иона сидит уже около большой грязной печи.
reading.question: Where does Iona end up about an hour and a half later?
options: Sitting near a large dirty stove (in the cabmen's lodging)
Back at his own village home
At the hospital where his son died
reading.correct: Sitting near a large dirty stove (in the cabmen's lodging)
reading.explain: About an hour and a half later, Iona is sitting near a large, dirty stove.

reading.ru: В одном из углов поднимается молодой извозчик, сонно крякает и тянется к ведру с водой.
reading.question: Who wakes up briefly in the lodging room and reaches for water?
reading.correct: A young cab driver
reading.explain: In one of the corners a young cab driver gets up, grunts sleepily, and reaches for the bucket of water.

reading.ru: У меня брат, сын, помер.
reading.question: What does Iona tell the young cabman who wakes up for water?
options: That he needs a place to sleep
reading.correct: That his son has died
reading.explain: Iona tells the young cabman that his son has died.

reading.ru: Он одевается и идет в конюшню, где стоит его лошадь.
reading.question: Where does Iona go since he cannot find a human listener?
options: To the stable, where his horse is kept
Back out onto the street to find another fare
To bed to try to sleep
reading.correct: To the stable, where his horse is kept
reading.explain: Unable to talk about his son with the sleeping men, Iona gets dressed and goes to the stable where his horse stands.

highlight.question: Which sentence emphasizes both the horse's immobility and its unnatural, puppet-like appearance?
sentences: Извозчик Иона Потапов весь бел, как привидение.
Он согнулся, насколько только возможно согнуться живому телу, сидит на козлах и не шевельнется.
Упади на него целый сугроб, то и тогда бы, кажется, он не нашел нужным стряхивать с себя снег…
Его лошаденка тоже бела и неподвижна.
Своею неподвижностью, угловатостью форм и палкообразной прямизною ног она даже вблизи похожа на копеечную пряничную лошадку.
highlight.explain: The sentence describes how the horse's stillness, angular form, and stick-like legs made it resemble a cheap gingerbread toy even when seen up close.

highlight.question: Which sentence shows the driver making a habitual gesture rather than a necessary one?
sentences: В знак согласия Иона дергает вожжи, отчего со спины лошади и с его плеч сыплются пласты снега…
Военный садится в сани.
Извозчик чмокает губами, вытягивает по-лебединому шею, приподнимается и больше по привычке, чем по нужде, машет кнутом.
Лошаденка тоже вытягивает шею, кривит свои палкообразные ноги и нерешительно двигается с места…
highlight.explain: The cabby waves his whip more out of habit than any real need to hurry the horse.

highlight.question: Which sentence contains the passenger's angry exclamation expressing frustration?
sentences: – Тьфу, чтоб тебя черти!..
– возмущается горбач.
– Поедешь ты, старая холера, или нет?
Разве так ездят?
Хлобысни-ка ее кнутом!
Хорошенько ее!
highlight.explain: The sentence captures the hunchback's initial profane outburst expressing his exasperation.

highlight.question: Which sentence conveys the passenger's despair about their survival of the journey?
sentences: – Все помрем…
– вздыхает горбач, вытирая после кашля губы.
– Ну, погоняй, погоняй!
Господа, я решительно не могу дальше так ехать!
Когда он нас довезет?
highlight.explain: The passenger sighs out that they will all die, expressing deep anxiety about the dangerous state of the ride.

highlight.question: Which sentence captures Iona's desperate need for anyone to listen to his grief?
sentences: Опять он одинок, и опять наступает для него тишина…
Утихшая ненадолго тоска появляется вновь и распирает грудь еще с большей силой.
Глаза Ионы тревожно и мученически бегают по толпам, снующим по обе стороны улицы: не найдется ли из этих тысяч людей хоть один, который выслушал бы его?
Но толпы бегут, не замечая ни его, ни тоски…
Тоска громадная, не знающая границ.
highlight.explain: Iona's eyes search through the crowds looking for even one person among thousands who would hear him and his suffering.

highlight.question: Which sentence reveals Iona's regret about returning to his home?
sentences: И лошаденка, точно поняв его мысль, начинает бежать рысцой.
Спустя часа полтора Иона сидит уже около большой, грязной печи.
На печи, на полу, на скамьях храпит народ.
В воздухе «спираль» и духота…
Иона глядит на спящих, почесывается и жалеет, что так рано вернулся домой…
highlight.explain: Looking at the sleeping people in the stuffy quarters, Iona regrets that he came back so early from his solitary work.
